evidence_boundary: Normative policy only. No claim that current CI, release readiness, or individual scores meet thresholds until verified against the exact SHA.

value_functions.name: Safety before capability
value_functions.principle: Security, dependency and fail-closed gates precede feature promotion.
measurable_invariants: secret detector must reject unknown credentials
dependency integrity failure blocks PR
missing security evidence never resolves to PASS
failure_modes: security gate disabled or not executed

value_functions.name: Truthfulness over presentation
value_functions.principle: Schema-valid evidence does not imply a measured or falsified result.
measurable_invariants: research artifact truth rejects zero-data PASS
claims compiler rejects unanchored claims
unsupported empirical promotion remains blocked
failure_modes: claims gate reports success without evidence

value_functions.name: User and operator value
value_functions.principle: Engineering work must expose actionable uncertainty, recovery paths, and decision constraints.
measurable_invariants: declared project-governance requirements testable
missing decision evidence produces an actionable failure
value policy has an executable negative self-test
failure_modes: subjective value claims without measurable surface

value_functions.name: Reproducibility and provenance
value_functions.principle: Evidence must be deterministically bound to immutable input bytes and exact version.
measurable_invariants: root SHA256 manifest cold-verifies tracked files
changing one committed source byte fails root manifest
source graph references a valid ancestor digest

value_functions.name: Technical leadership through falsification
value_functions.principle: Improve explicit disconfirming tests before expanding scientific or product claims.
measurable_invariants: negative Ricci replay holds claim at HYPOTHESIS
falsifiers reject altered provenance pins
mutation gate detects ineffective assertions
failure_modes: synthetic test misrepresented as market evidence

value_functions.name: Cooperative auditability
value_functions.principle: Another reviewer can reproduce file-bound checks and audit rollback conditions.
measurable_invariants: relative documentation links resolve
release receipts distinguish NOT_READY from READY
repository integrity commands are independently executable

value_functions.name: Minimal power concentration in automation
value_functions.principle: Automation reports evidence, while irreversible actions require explicit authorized policy.
measurable_invariants: reviewable branch policy guards mainline merges
hard constraints cannot be softened through a config edit
validator self-test must detect its own bypass
failure_modes: confidence language substituted for an executable gate
